## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow, technology-dominated leadership (top performers concentrated in Tech) alongside broad sector weakness and multiple large-cap divergences supports a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Real Estate are marginally positive this week (see sector table).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication, Energy and Consumer Staples lag: TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Style: Growth/Momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -15.96%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -8.71% | 1M: +15.29%) CORRECTION; NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W movers: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: several large-cap Tech names show 1W/1M mismatch (LRCX, AMAT, ASML RECOVERY; CRM, MSFT CORRECTION) — watch for trend breaks rather than assuming a broad rotation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leadership concentrated at the top: AAPL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +8.89%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.25%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.00%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed to weak: JPM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND but sector 1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.83% with most names underperforming — selective exposure to resilient franchises favored.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing modest participation: JNJ (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.29%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: +1.12% | 1M: -2.52%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Growth/Momentum winners within Tech (META, NVDA, AMD) while reducing exposure to Communication laggards and beaten-down high-multiple names; stay size-conscious given narrow leadership and MAJOR divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.00%) on concentrated leadership. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -5.47%) and Energy (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +0.96%) for continued dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND — sustained next-week follow-through would confirm a broader tech push; AAPL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +8.89%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold recent support would signal waning leadership; INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND — watch for volatility fade or re-acceleration.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
META (+60): Muse AI headline; META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms price momentum. XOM (+65): record output headline; XOM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through. CRM (+55): positive commentary on strategy; CRM (1W: -8.71% | 1M: +15.29%) CORRECTION — news is not yet confirming price (short-term weakness).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TMUS (-55): JPM downgrade headline; TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms weakness. GOOGL (-50): regulatory headlines; GOOGL (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, monitor for policy risk. HD (-50): consumer warning; HD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -10.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style. META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND show clear relative strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and MAJOR divergence (multiple large-cap 1W/1M mismatches) with mixed news confirmations that warrant caution.
